name: trace_feature
description: Search provider string and procedure inventories for the complete literal query, preserving spaces, then query xrefs at each matched start address. References to interior bytes of strings and procedures are not searched. An empty result or truncated: false does not prove there are no references. Preserve an explicit unavailable owner for a non-retryable containment capability refusal; reference kinds remain unknown. For a procedure match, use procedure_references with direction incoming for provider-reported kinds when supported; it covers the procedure body, so compare target addresses when selecting exact-entry references. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and page matches, references and unknowns with inspect_analysis_view kind native-feature-trace.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
